items_flat.title_en: Google releases Gemini 3.7 Flash, its most intelligent workhorse model for coding and agents
items_flat.title_zh: Google 發布 Gemini 3.7 Flash，其 Flash 系列最智能的編程與代理工作模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced Gemini 3.7 Flash on August 13 as the most intelligent model in its Flash series for coding, knowledge work and agents. It delivers substantial gains over 3.6 Flash on coding benchmarks (FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%, DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%) and WebDev Arena, with introductory pricing of $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens (half the prior rate) through year-end.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 於 8 月 13 日宣布 Gemini 3.7 Flash，作為 Flash 系列中最智能的編程、知識工作與代理模型。相較 3.6 Flash，編程基準大幅提升（FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%、DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%），並提供年底前 $0.75/$3.75 每百萬 token 的導入定價（為先前價格一半）。
items_flat.analysis_en: The three-week follow-up to 3.6 Flash plus aggressive intro pricing shows Google prioritising rapid iteration and cost-performance in the agentic workhorse segment. Key uncertainty remains how quickly the gains translate to production agent reliability versus flagship Pro models still in testing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 距離 3.6 Flash 僅三週就推出，並搭配積極導入定價，顯示 Google 正優先快速迭代並強化代理工作模型的性價比。關鍵不確定性在於這些提升能多快轉化為生產環境代理的可靠性，以及仍在測試中的旗艦 Pro 模型表現。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re building on the progress of our widely used Flash series by introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash, our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們在廣泛使用的 Flash 系列基礎上推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，這是我們迄今最智能的編程與代理工作模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14× the speed via Cerebras
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽 Ultrafast 模式：GPT-5.6 Sol 透過 Cerebras 最高達 14 倍速度
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Ultrafast, a new API tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14× faster than standard processing and generates up to 750 output tokens per second, powered by Cerebras. The limited preview is available today to a select group of customers, with expansion planned as capacity grows.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 Ultrafast 新 API 層級，讓 GPT-5.6 Sol 以最高 14 倍於標準處理的速度運行，並由 Cerebras 驅動每秒最高產生 750 個輸出 token。有限預覽今日對選定客戶開放，容量增加後將逐步擴大。
items_flat.analysis_en: Pairing frontier intelligence with extreme speed removes a key barrier for real-time agentic and interactive applications. Uncertainty centres on when (and at what price) Ultrafast becomes broadly available beyond the current limited preview.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將前沿智能與極致速度結合，移除了即時代理與互動應用的關鍵障礙。不確定性在於 Ultrafast 何時（以及以何種價格）從目前有限預覽擴大至更廣泛可用。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re sharing an early look at Ultrafast, a new service tier that runs GPT‑5.6 Sol up to 14× faster than Standard processing... Powered by Cerebras, Ultrafast generates up to 750 output tokens per second.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們分享 Ultrafast 的早期預覽，這是一個新的服務層級，讓 GPT-5.6 Sol 以最高 14 倍於標準處理的速度運行……由 Cerebras 驅動，Ultrafast 每秒最高產生 750 個輸出 token。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Computer History in ChatGPT desktop app for Mac
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Mac 桌面版推出 Computer History 功能
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released Computer History, an opt-in feature in the ChatGPT desktop app on macOS that records interaction events across selected apps and websites (not screenshots) to build a searchable timeline and memories. It replaces the Chronicle research preview and is available to Pro, Business and Enterprise users (admins must enable for workspaces).
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布 Computer History，這是 ChatGPT macOS 桌面版的選擇性功能，記錄選定 app 與網站的互動事件（非截圖）以建立可搜尋時間軸與記憶。它取代 Chronicle 研究預覽，開放給 Pro、Business 與 Enterprise 用戶（工作區需管理員啟用）。
items_flat.analysis_en: Giving the model persistent, user-controlled context from the local desktop moves ChatGPT closer to a true personal agent. Privacy design and opt-in nature will determine real-world adoption and trust.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 讓模型從本地桌面獲得持續且由用戶控制的情境，使 ChatGPT 更接近真正的個人代理。隱私設計與選擇性啟用將決定實際採用率與信任度。
items_flat.quote: ChatGPT can now remember your activity across the apps and websites on your computer. With Computer History in the desktop app, future interactions feel more personalized and require less explanation.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT 現在可以記住你在電腦上 app 與網站的活動。有了桌面版的 Computer History，未來的互動會更個人化，也更少需要解釋。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic updates Claude Tag to read more of the room with ~30% better proactive decisions
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 更新 Claude Tag，全頻道脈絡下主動決策準確率約提升 30%
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic released an update to Claude Tag (its Slack agent) that lets Claude use full channel context, memory and standing instructions to decide when and how to contribute. The model now chooses among four moves—reply inline, start a thread, route to existing work, or stay silent—and is roughly 30% better at proactive timing, at no extra cost.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 更新 Claude Tag（其 Slack 代理），讓 Claude 使用完整頻道脈絡、記憶與常設指示來決定何時與如何貢獻。模型現在可在四種行動中選擇——內聯回覆、開新討論串、導向既有工作或保持沉默——主動時機準確率約提升 30%，且無額外費用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moving from a simple classifier to richer context-aware behaviour makes Claude more useful as a collaborative agent rather than a reactive bot. Real-world value will depend on how well teams calibrate the new proactive controls.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 從簡單分類器轉向更豐富的脈絡感知行為，使 Claude 更適合作為協作代理而非被動機器人。實際價值將取決於團隊如何校準新的主動控制機制。
items_flat.quote: As a result, Claude is now roughly 30% better at determining when, and when not, to proactively respond.
items_flat.quote_zh: 因此，Claude 現在在決定何時主動回應、何時不回應方面大約提升了 30%。
